decisions.rule: Separate Coinbase's gains on crypto held for investment from transaction revenue, subscription/services revenue and operating income. Do not treat the $715.0M Q3 fair-value gain as customer trading revenue or XRP demand.
decisions.rationale: SEC 10-Q reports $715.022M gains on crypto held for investment, primarily fair-value remeasurement of BTC and ETH; Coinbase says those holdings are primarily long-term and not part of regular trading.

decisions.rule: Treat $1.3B crypto held as collateral and $389.7M crypto borrowed as aggregate balances only. Do not allocate them to XRP without token-level disclosure.
decisions.rationale: The public filing does not disclose token composition for these aggregate balances.

decisions.rule: Do not infer Coinbase's XRP proprietary holding from the $314M other-crypto investment category. No individual other-crypto position exceeded 5% of total fair value, and XRP is not separately named.
decisions.rationale: The filing identifies BTC and ETH but aggregates the remaining assets.

decisions.rule: Keep Coinbase's 10.7% reported crypto trading-volume market share separate from exchange-only competitor metrics unless stablecoin-conversion inclusion and competitor sets are harmonized.
decisions.rationale: Coinbase's Q3 deck says the market-share series was adjusted to capture stablecoin-conversion activity.

decisions.rule: Track market-share, USDC balances, subscription revenue and derivatives/prediction-market growth alongside total revenue, transaction revenue, adjusted EBITDA and fair-value gains.
decisions.rationale: Coinbase reported market-share and product growth while Q3 revenue declined 35%, transaction revenue declined 44%, and Adjusted EBITDA declined 58% year over year.
